customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as Taskfile vars are invisible to the gomod manager, so they rot until a toolchain bump breaks the gate (go-arch-lint v1.15.0 stopped working under Go 1.27).

packageRules.description: Flag major updates for manual review — there is no CI (meta ADR-0001), so run `task check` / `npm run check` locally before merging one.
